verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is budget alerts: users can set a spending threshold that automatically sends an alert when it may be exceeded. That is a narrow, notification-only form of an event-triggered rule. Nothing in the pack documents a general event-rule engine that fires arbitrary actions such as functions, workflows or remediation on resource or service events. Missing for 10: a general-purpose events/rules service, configurable actions beyond alerts, coverage of resource-lifecycle and service events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
